### Data Visualization
```{r ind team histograms}
season     <- '2324'
league_acro <- 'PL'
league     <- 'Premier'

X          <- read_data(season, league)
X1         <- X[[1]];  X2 <- X[[2]]
df_hist    <- read_historics(season, league_acro)
team_names <- sort(unique(df_hist[, "HomeTeam"]))
N          <- length(team_names)
rownames(X1) <- team_names
rownames(X2) <- team_names

# ── 1. Manually assign teams to three colour groups ───────────
#       Fill in the team indices (1:N) as you like
group1_idx <- c(1, 5, 8, 10, 15)          # e.g. colour 1
group2_idx <- c(3, 11, 12, 13, 16, 18, 19, 20)      # e.g. colour 2
group3_idx <- c(2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 14, 17)  # e.g. colour 3

# group1_idx <- c()          # e.g. colour 1
# group2_idx <- c()      # e.g. colour 2
# group3_idx <- 1:20  # e.g. colour 3

group_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#009E73",   # green
  "2" = "#D55E00",   # blue
  "3" = "#87CEEB"    # orange
)

# ══ TOGGLE BLOCK ══════════════════════════════════════════════
apply_effects   <- TRUE  # ← single switch: FALSE = plain view
lowlight_groups <- c(3)  # group numbers to fade out
lowlight_alpha  <- 0.15  # how transparent the faded plots become
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_group <- function(j) {
  if (j %in% group1_idx) return(1)
  if (j %in% group2_idx) return(2)
  if (j %in% group3_idx) return(3)
  return(NA)
}

# ── Build plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────
plots <- list()

for (j in 1:N) {
  goals      <- unname(append(X1[j, ], X2[, j]))
  goals      <- goals[!is.na(goals)]
  mean_goals <- mean(goals)
  var_goals  <- var(goals)

  grp         <- get_group(j)
  fill_col    <- if (is.na(grp)) "grey60" else group_colors[as.character(grp)]
  do_lowlight <- apply_effects && !is.na(grp) && (grp %in% lowlight_groups)

  p <- ggplot(data.frame(goals), aes(x = goals)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 7), ylim = c(0, 15)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = fill_col, color = 'black') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_goals,
               linetype = "solid",  color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = var_goals,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "#8E44AD", linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggtitle(team_names[j]) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )

  if (do_lowlight) {
    g          <- ggplotGrob(p)
    plots[[j]] <- gTree(children = gList(g), gp = gpar(alpha = lowlight_alpha))
  } else {
    plots[[j]] <- p
  }
}

#do.call("grid.arrange", c(plots, nrow = 4, ncol = 5,left = 'Number of Matches', bottom = 'Goals'))
```

### Slides
```{r spike-and-slab viz}
library(ggplot2)

# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────
spike_mean   <- 1      # spike (approximate point-mass) at ν_i = 1
spike_sd     <- 0.05   # very narrow
slab_meanlog <- 0      # log-normal centred at exp(0) = 1
slab_sdlog   <- 0.7    # diffuse slab
w            <- 0.5    # equal mixture weights

# ν_i ∈ (0, 4)
x <- seq(0.001, 4, length.out = 5000)

d_spike <- w * dnorm(x,  mean    = spike_mean,   sd     = spike_sd)
d_slab  <- w * dlnorm(x, meanlog = slab_meanlog, sdlog  = slab_sdlog)
d_mix   <- d_spike + d_slab

df <- data.frame(x = x, mix = d_mix, spike = d_spike, slab = d_slab)

# ── Arrow / label positions ───────────────────────────────────
y_max   <- max(d_mix)
arrow_y <- y_max * 0.025 - 0.5   # just above the x-axis line
label_y <- y_max * 0.075 - 1.2    # label sits further below arrow
gap     <- 0.03            # small gap either side of ν_i = 1

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p = ggplot(df, aes(x = x)) +

  # Mixture density — red, no fill
  geom_line(aes(y = mix),
            colour = "red3", linewidth = 1.0) +

  # Spike component — steel blue, dashed
  geom_line(aes(y = spike),
            colour = "steelblue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Slab component — dark orchid, dot-dash (clearly different from spike)
  geom_line(aes(y = slab),
            colour = "darkorchid", linetype = 
              "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Vertical reference at ν_i = 1
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # ── Over-dispersion arrow (orange): ν_i ∈ (0, 1) ────────────
  annotate("segment",
           x    = 0.03,       xend = 1 - gap,
           y    = arrow_y,    yend = arrow_y,
           colour    = "forestgreen",
           linewidth = 0.95,
           arrow = arrow(ends   = "both", type = "open",
                         length = unit(0.13, "inches"))) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = label_y+0.15,
           label  = "Over-dispersion",
           colour = "forestgreen", size = 3.7, fontface = "italic") +

  # ── Under-dispersion arrow (firebrick): ν_i ∈ (1, 4) ────────
  annotate("segment",
           x    = 1 + gap,    xend = 3.97,
           y    = arrow_y,    yend = arrow_y,
           colour    = "darkorange",
           linewidth = 0.95,
           arrow = arrow(ends   = "both", type = "open",
                         length = unit(0.13, "inches"))) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2.5, y = label_y+0.15,
           label  = "Under-dispersion",
           colour = "darkorange", size = 3.7, fontface = "italic") +

  # ── Scales & theme ────────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 4), breaks = 0:4) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.3, y_max * 1.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
    breaks = c(0,1,2,3,4)
  ) +
  labs(x = expression(nu[i]), y = "Density") +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.4, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"),  # generous bottom margin
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.line   = element_line(colour = "grey40"),
    axis.ticks  = element_line(colour = "grey40")
  )
```

#### Figure 7

```{r fig7 setup}
# require(ggridges)
league_acro = 'PL'
season = '2324'
n_run = 1
load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/SAS_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run",n_run,"_SAS_N_Final.RData"))
MH_object = MH_SAS
t = MH_object$iterations
N = length(MH_object$team_names)

nus = MH_object$nu_post[(t/5):t, ]
nus[nus == 1] = NA

quantiles = apply(nus, 2, function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE))

classify = function(low, high) {
  if (low > 1.1) {
    return("Underdispersed")
  } else if (high < 0.9) {
    return("Overdispersed")
  } else {
    return("Equidispersed")
  }
}

group_colors = c("Underdispersed" = "#D55E00", "Overdispersed" = "#009E73", "Equidispersed" = "gray")

groups = mapply(classify, quantiles[1, ], quantiles[2, ])
names(groups) =  MH_object$team_names

p_z1 = retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post, (t/5)+1, t)[1,]
names(p_z1) = MH_SAS$team_names

groups[p_z1 < 0.49] = "Equidispersed"

df_long = as.data.frame(nus)
colnames(df_long) = MH_object$team_names

df_long = df_long |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "team", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  mutate(group = groups[team]) |>
  mutate(log_value = log(value),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Underdispersed", "Equidispersed", "Overdispersed"))
        )

team_levels = levels(summary_df$team)
p_z1 = p_z1[team_levels]

df_z1 = data.frame(
  team = factor(names(p_z1), levels = levels(summary_df$team)),
  p_z1 = as.numeric(p_z1)
)

summary_df = df_long |>
  group_by(team, group) |>
  mutate(team = factor(team, levels = levels(summary_df$team))) |>
  arrange(team)
```

```{r fig7 plot}
p_a <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(
  x = log_value,
  y = factor(team, levels = unique(team)), # reverse to match histogram
  fill = group
)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1,             
    rel_min_height = 0.01, 
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +   
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(a)",
    x = expression(log ~ P(nu[i] ~ "|" ~ Z[i] == 1, bold(Y))),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7)

offset = 0
p_b <- ggplot(df_z1, aes(
  x = p_z1,
  y = factor(team, levels = (unique(team)))  # match order of rows
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "skyblue3", width = 0.7,
           position = position_nudge(y = -offset)) +   # shift bars down
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", p_z1)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.3,
            position = position_nudge(y = -offset)) +  # shift text
  annotate("segment", x = 0.49, xend = 0.49, y = 0.5, yend = 20.87,
            color = "red3",
            linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.5
          ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = c(1, 20.87)) +
  labs(
    title = "(b)",
    x = expression(P(Z[i] == 1 ~ "|" ~ bold(Y))),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(b = 2)),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

combined_fig7 = p_a + p_b

ggsave(
  "Plots/Figure7_SlabDensityZ.png",
  plot = combined_fig7,
  width = 1600,
  height = 1200,
  units = "px",
  dpi = 300
)
```

#### Table

```{r table setup}
league = 'Premier'
league_acro = 'PL'
season = '2324'

X = read_data(season, league)
X1 = X[[1]]
X2 = X[[2]]

load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/SAS_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run1_SAS_N_Final.RData"))

sas_pars = retrieve_pars_summ(MH_SAS, burn_in = 0.2)[,1]
t = MH_SAS$iterations
names(sas_pars) = rownames(retrieve_pars_summ(MH_SAS))
retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post, (t/5), t)[1,]

load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/Pois_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run1_Pois.RData"))

pois_pars = retrieve_pars_summ(MH_P, burn_in = 0.2)[,1]
names(pois_pars) = rownames(retrieve_pars_summ(MH_P))


df_table = cbind(pois_pars[2:21],
                 pois_pars[22:41],
                 sas_pars[2:21],
                 sas_pars[22:41],
                 log(sas_pars[42:61]),
                 retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post,  (t/5), t)[1,])

df_sd = cbind(apply(MH_P$att_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_P$def_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_SAS$att_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_SAS$def_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(log(MH_SAS$nu_post[(t/5):t,]), 2, sd))
df_sd = round(df_sd[order(-df_table[,5]),],3)

rownames(df_table) = MH_SAS$team_names

df_table = cbind(round(df_table[,1:5], 3),
                 round(df_table[,6], 2))

df_sort = df_table[order(-df_table[,5]),]
df_sort_means = df_sort

df_sort_medians = df_sort

df_latex <- df_sort_means %>%
  as.data.frame()

df_latex_sep <- data.frame(
  Mean1 = df_sort_means[,1],
  SD1   = df_sd[,1],
  Mean2 = df_sort_means[,2],
  SD2   = df_sd[,2],
  Mean3 = df_sort_means[,3],
  SD3   = df_sd[,3],
  Mean4 = df_sort_means[,4],
  SD4   = df_sd[,4],
  Mean5 = df_sort_means[,5],
  SD5   = df_sd[,5]
)

kable(
  df_latex_sep,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", rep(c("S[table-format=1.3]", "c"), 5)), # mean=S, SD=l
  escape = FALSE
) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Var1" = 2, "Var2" = 2, "Var3" = 2, "Var4" = 2, "Var5" = 2))

# Keep rownames italicized
rownames(df_latex_sep) <- paste0("\\textit{", rownames(df_latex_sep), "}")


for (j in 1:5) {
  df_latex[[j]] <- sprintf(
    "%.3f {(%.2f)}",
    df_latex[[j]],
    df_sd[, j]
  )
}

rn <- rownames(df_latex)
rownames(df_latex) <- paste0("\\textit{", rn, "}")

# ---- 3. LaTeX table ----
latex_table = kable(
  df_latex,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,                        # cleaner table, no row-by-row hlines
  align = c("l", rep("S", ncol(df_latex) - 1)),# row name column is left-aligned
  escape = FALSE                          # allow italic row names
)
```
